name: @dbc/trellis
description: A framework for roblox-ts games: services, controllers, and typed contracts between the server and its clients.

scripts.build:specs: rbxtsc -p tsconfig.spec.json --type game --rojo scripts/spec.project.json -i build/include && rojo build scripts/spec.project.json --output build/spec.rbxl
scripts.check:specs: npm run build:specs && lune run scripts/run-specs.luau build/spec.rbxl
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run check:format && npm run check:deadcode && npm run check:specs

author: Ali
